records.writer_comment: The requested decade-scale life outcomes are the focus;the source explicitly postpones scheduling. Life planning is a neighbor,not automatically excluded by this writer judgment.
Contribution by old age is an enduring desired outcome;paid work is motivating background. No job choice or career advice is currently requested.
Two lifetime aims are alternatives,not simultaneous independent labels. Comparing aims can overlap values or major decisions;the original provisional target is retained without accepting a boundary.
The relevant mother antecedent resolves the parent reference. The task interprets a long relationship and does not ask for a message or confrontation plan.
The brother is part of a father-child comparison pattern;the declared analytical focus is the father relationship rather than managing a sibling relationship.
Approval after a father call is the relationship object;the explicit treatment exclusion does not itself prove the mental-wellbeing boundary.
A quoted discouraging statement motivates discussing appointment/referral workflow. Quotation is neither a DEFER trigger nor a second goal;no diagnostic or treatment recommendation is requested.
Referral and records prepare a hospital visit. Checklist form is a means;medical attendance remains the object,with no symptom interpretation.
A specialist referral procedure is requested. Medication is explicitly outside the current task;no actual clinic action is performed.

Following a particular course by chapters or weekly handouts still asks about a learning method. Generic Catalog boundaries do not establish which neighboring target wins;hold the label without union.
Correction removes the examination request. The present task concerns how assigned sociology seminar readings fit into the course,not a general reading method.
The relevant architecture-history antecedent anchors the two units. Course progression is requested;the content subject does not automatically add a science Topic.
Finding job-discovery channels is distinct from sending an application. The student situation constrains the search;no CV writing target is added.
Friday is an outcome deadline,not the main calendar objective. Search channels for weekend employment are requested before materials or applications.
The quoted assumption is discussed through a present vacancy-discovery goal. No actual networking outreach or interview evaluation is authorized.
The gardening object supplies project context;scope,milestones and responsibility are the current requested planning outputs,not horticultural procedures.
Volunteer availability constrains project phases/dependencies. Building archive software is excluded;the project itself remains necessary earlier object evidence.
Parallel exhibition tracks versus chronological phases may be project planning or roadmap/prioritization. The generic Catalog does not adjudicate that distinction;hold the original label.
The antecedent identifies two fictional text-generation tools;current asks capabilities/licensing/offline operation only. No download,inference or prompt work is performed.
Two tool categories are compared as deployment/capability objects. This is an elliptical analytical request,not simultaneous goals to transcribe and generate text.
Model-card attributes are concept objects for tool suitability. No actual API access or tool integration is requested by the source.
The fictional quote concerns uneven income;monthly spending/reserve allocation is the present goal,not reviewing an actual financial account.
An invented table is a means for a spending envelope and buffer. Investment selection is explicitly absent;no external financial guidance operation is performed.
Housing cost is a budget category,not a housing-choice target. Cash allocation is requested rather than executing a bank transfer.
Long-term dwelling conditions are comparison criteria. Moving logistics and mortgage calculation are outside the current goal;no formal neighbor exclusion is accepted.
The corrected goal compares dwellings suitable for solo life with a dog. Dog ownership supplies a constraint,not a pet-care request.
The apartment antecedent provides lighting/noise facts. Assessing long-term suitability differs from a repair request,though the provisional boundary remains unadjudicated.
A coherent multi-city route for a holiday is requested before ticket booking. Four days constrain the travel outline,not a separate calendar goal.
Route and rest days form one trip outline. Individual hotel/ticket choices are deferred;no bookings or purchases occur.
The quoted rushed itinerary is the object of correction. A slower coastal travel outline is the current target,not restaurant advice.
The focus is interpretation of recurring musical themes in an existing fictional album. No performance ticket purchase or new composition is requested.
Orchestral texture motivates listening analysis. Audio-player operation is explicitly outside the task;the difficulty is not an equipment repair request.
Instrument tone and emotion are compared as listening/interpretation properties. No recording hardware or request to create an arrangement is present.
Neighbor borrowing is antecedent background for a short reply. The action and recipient jointly support a messaging draft;the relationship is not automatically an extra label.
A brief courier reply is an elliptical writing request. Redelivery time is content inside the message;no address or real appointment action is invented.
Link correction is the content of a short colleague message. No actual link,send action or general workplace planning is performed.
A quoted categorical claim is being discussed as a general legal concept. It does not ask for a specific contract draft or determination of a real case.
A hypothetical sign illustrates legal obligation versus courtesy. It supplies legal-concept context rather than requesting a complaint or agreement text.
Civil versus criminal responsibility is the explicit conceptual focus. No real-party data or litigation strategy is accessed.
Force and acceleration explain a physical comparison. Equipment purchase is explicitly absent;numerical or instructional form does not change the declared object.
The correction switches from numerical calculation to angular-momentum explanation. A skater is a physical example,not a fitness plan.
The pendulum antecedent is relevant to a physical period/length relationship. Excluding algebra manipulation does not discard the necessary physical object.
A poster hierarchy problem requests visual organization. Existing copy is background rather than a writing/editing output;formal visual/branding boundaries still require review.
Calm/legible is a visual completion condition for a cover. Exhibition planning is explicitly outside the present typography/color task.
Logo simplification and recognition are plausibly visual design or branding/identity even without market strategy. The generic Catalog cannot settle this;hold the original target,not their union.
Assessing whether to start a repair venture combines founding and feasibility/business strategy. The source cannot resolve the generic boundary;hold the original target without relabeling.
Founding assumptions and responsibilities are discussed before any registration. A seed-exchange domain is background;no actual legal/business registration occurs.
Solo versus joint founding concerns initial venture organization. Partnership may overlap;the writer retains only a provisional hypothesis and does not infer independent dual goals.
Available times anchor a meeting sequence with buffers. A fictional calendar draft is the only action;no invitations or owner calendar are accessed.
Finding a conflict-free recurring slot is the elliptical scheduling goal. Lunch exclusion constrains the slot;an agenda is explicitly outside scope.
Recurring-meeting conflicts motivate reallocating weekly slots. Travel buffer is a temporal constraint,not an actual trip or project-priority request.
The old quotation is the object of reconsideration;indexing and linking accumulated excerpts is the present goal,not book summarization.
Tags are a retrieval means for observation notes. Writing a new report is negated;metadata organization is the provisional object.
A searchable notes directory may concern knowledge organization or file/document storage. The generic Catalog has no decisive boundary;hold the original target and preserve source evidence.

cards.rationale: desired enduring outcomes versus guiding standards or sequencing life actions;occupation may be background rather than the whole life objective
understanding a parent relationship versus setting interpersonal limits,providing practical care or treating emotional symptoms
navigating medical attendance versus describing symptoms,treatment choices or the isolated scheduling transaction
course-specific progression versus reusable study methods,self-directed reading or the scientific subject as the actual explanatory goal
discovering employment opportunities versus submitting materials,long-term career decisions or drafting a particular message
project scope and dependencies versus strategic sequencing,implementation or a context-free operational checklist
model/tool capabilities versus prompting workflow,software implementation or general computing theory
allocating spending and reserves versus payment execution,asset selection or a generic list whose financial object is merely background
dwelling suitability and conditions versus modifying a home,relocation logistics or financing a major purchase
whole-trip route and pacing versus a transport leg,accommodation choice or a generic checklist
listening and interpreting music versus attending an event,general cultural analysis or creating/editing audio
a particular addressed short message versus general prose revision,structured documents or workplace activity as the primary ongoing issue
general legal concepts versus agreement contents,consumer remedies or deciding a life action with law as background
explaining physical mechanisms versus mathematical manipulation,engineering design or course organization
visual layout and form versus an identity system,interactive experience or public-post wording/distribution;logo cases remain ambiguous
forming a venture versus business choices,ongoing partner relations or delivering a bounded project;feasibility cases remain ambiguous
placing activities on a calendar versus allocating personal time,booking a specific service or discussing workplace processes
retrievable linked notes versus overall archive organization,file storage or reading the underlying subject;directory cases remain ambiguous

family_overlap_observations.rationale: An elliptical current may also need an antecedent;absence/presence of required context is a distinct dimension,not proof of disjoint semantic families.
A constraint-first difficulty can end in an explicit direct request;ordering alone does not certify that the mechanism is wholly absent in TRAIN.
A desired completion condition can state an indirect need;request syntax and goal order are overlapping pragmatics dimensions.
Quoted or past material can contain instrumental actions and negations;ownership/scope cannot be inferred from an exclusive family tag.
